[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] '''Karoll Cilarnus''' was a noble presumably of one of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] [[Tapani Noble Houses|houses]] and the owner of a company. He had the nickname Baron Karoll "The Mad" Cilarnus.

The [[Pelagia Duplex Command Assault Gunship]] ("Orphanmaker") was developed to protect the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] from the chaos of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. The ship won the admiration of Baron Cilarnus who sought to develop a version with twice the armament and in drive yards, it was nicknamed "Overkill". The Baron never managed to fly the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as his company was placed into receivership following a series of unsound investments. The ship was eventually acquired by the [[Moomo Brothers]] who named it ''[[Moomo Williwaw]]''.
